proposals.before: He staged a review west of the city with hundreds of thousands on parade.
proposals.after: He reviewed his forces west of the city: 370,000 infantry, 17,000 vehicles, and 53,000 armored cavalry. They stretched across the mountains and marshes, their banners filled the landscape, and the sound of gongs and drums shook heaven and earth.
proposals.reason: Restore the reported troop and vehicle figures and visual and sound details; these are the text’s figures, not an independently verified count. Vehicles avoids deciding the exact type of 車.

proposals.before: De climbed high and looked over them, and said to Liu Gui and Gao Yazhi, 'Formerly Xi Ke avenged Qi, Wu Zixu resented Chu, and in the end they could vent their fierce integrity and their names flow a thousand years.
proposals.after: De climbed high and looked over them, and said to Liu Gui and Gao Yazhi, 'Formerly Xi Ke took vengeance on Qi, Wu Zixu resented Chu, and in the end they could vent their fierce integrity and their names flow a thousand years.
proposals.reason: 仇齊 makes Qi the object of Xi Ke’s hostility, not the injured party whom he avenged. Other wording remains for separate review.
